title: Production Scheduling Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Production Scheduling Assistant Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Describe the role of production scheduling in the supply chain.
Understand essential production scheduling concepts, procedures and technologies.
Demonstrate fundamental skills in production scheduling, and work successfully as a Production Scheduling Assistant.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (LOGST201, LOGST202, LOGST206); these match closed-list LOGST 201, LOGST 202 and LOGST 206, so they are not marked as catalog additions.
An outer heading 'Production Scheduling Assistant (Total 9) Complete all of the following' wraps the single required block; recorded as one block.

The lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' appears twice; the first occurrence has no outcomes directly under it, and the outcomes are recorded from the Program Learning Outcomes heading.

Careers: 'production planning and scheduling' is taken from the description ('entry level jobs in production planning and scheduling'); 'Production Scheduling Assistant' is taken from the third outcome. Reviewer may wish to confirm both qualify.
